The conflict was fought in North America, the Caribbean, and the Atlantic Ocean. Outcome: American and allied victory; Signing of the United States Declaration of Independence in 1776.; Great Britain would not recognize American independence until signing the Treaty of Paris.; Peace of Paris; End of the First British Empire. events.x: The War of the Spanish Succession, 1701 to 1714, was a European great power conflict. The death of Charles II of Spain in November 1700 without children led to a succession crisis between Philip of Anjou, whose claim was supported by his grandfather, Louis XIV of France, and Archduke Charles of Austria, backed by the Grand Alliance. Outcome: Treaties of Utrecht, Rastatt, and Baden. Cost: Philip V recognised as King of Spain, but renounces his place in the French line of succession.; Spain cedes Milan, the Spanish Netherlands, Naples and Sardinia to Austria; Sicily to Savoy; Colonia del Sacramento to Portugal; and Great Britain retains Gibraltar and Menorca..
